name: Jahmyr Gibbs
commentary: Chapter Three says trust your first instinct before the world talks you out of it, so I am footnoting this twice: Jahmyr Gibbs, exactly where the board and the System agree, no deviation, no apology needed for once.

name: Caleb Williams
commentary: He's on the board in round one, that's the whole rule, no debate. Bijan can wait for someone soft — I'm building around Caleb Williams starting now.

name: Bijan Robinson
commentary: Bijan Robinson still on the board at pick THREE, folks?! Holy cow, that man runs like he stole something valuable and BEAUTIFUL — write it down, we are taking him!

name: Brock Bowers
commentary: A tight end at pick FOUR? Sweetie, CMC will still be a headline tomorrow — Brock Bowers is the plot twist nobody saw coming, and I OWN it.

name: Jonathan Taylor
commentary: The board wants McCaffrey; I want the feeling I have about a long road and a horse who does not tire on it. Jonathan Taylor. The reasons will introduce themselves in time.

name: Christian McCaffrey
commentary: CMC's still sat there at six, hun? Not asking twice — he's gorgeous on tape and he's mine now.

name: De'Von Achane
commentary: Everybody's grabbing receivers like it's a buffet line — I'm taking the kid who runs like he owes somebody money. De'Von Achane. Backs first, that's not a rule, that's respect.

name: Puka Nacua
commentary: Puka Nacua was a fifth-rounder nobody trusted, and he just outworked the whole depth chart to the top. That's the kind of receiver I build a program around.

name: Nico Collins
commentary: Monix takes his quarterback and thinks I don't see the next move coming — he wants a big receiver to feed Caleb Williams, so I'm taking Nico Collins right out from under him. Not spite. Strategy. Same thing, really.

name: CeeDee Lamb
commentary: CeeDee Lamb has a *brand*, Gary, he trends — that's the tape I care about. Selina Meyer takes the star, not the spreadsheet. Write that down.

name: Justin Jefferson
commentary: Justin Jefferson at eleven? That's not a reach, that's a launch — the name alone is a campaign, the stats are just a bonus feature.

name: Ja'Marr Chase
commentary: Ja'Marr Chase drops to twelve like the league forgot he exists. I didn't forget. Wasn't luck, wasn't the board — that's just where he was always ending up. Mine now.

name: Derrick Henry
commentary: Derrick Henry. I don't need the tape, I need the trembling — King Henry runs downhill, so do I.

name: Saquon Barkley
commentary: Saquon Barkley is a Super Bowl champion AND a superbrand — that's not a pick, that's a merger.

name: Josh Allen
commentary: Josh Allen dates a pop star and wins MVPs — Gary, that's not a quarterback, that's a magazine cover I get to own.

name: James Cook
commentary: Selina just took her quarterback, so obviously James Cook is next on her list — not obviously, but I'm not risking it, he's mine.

name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
commentary: Amon-Ra St. Brown doesn't outwork you by accident — that's a kid who earned every route. That's a program guy.

name: Chase Brown
commentary: Two backs, two rounds, that's not a coincidence, that's a family tradition. Chase Brown runs like he's got somewhere to be.

name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
commentary: Jaxon Smith-Njigba's got that main character energy on tape, hun — I fancy him, done.

name: George Pickens
commentary: A man arrives in a new house and finds it fits better than the old one ever did. George Pickens. The castle has many staircases.

name: Trey McBride
commentary: Two elite tight ends, one villain era — I'm cornering the TE market and forcing every league mate to talk about it.

name: Lamar Jackson
commentary: Lamar Jackson, folks, holy cow, he runs like a scalded cat and throws it like a strike — big name, bigger arm, he's MINE!

name: A.J. Brown
commentary: A.J. Brown takes the top off a defense. Caleb needs a bomb, not a check-down merchant.

name: Tee Higgins
commentary: The chapter says balance the foundation before you build higher, so: Tee Higgins, footnoted twice, no apology, thank you for reading this far.

name: Kenneth Walker
commentary: Chapter Three, page two: the foundation isn't finished until it's load-bearing. Kenneth Walker, no apology, no deviation.

name: Ashton Jeanty
commentary: Jeanty can end a game in two touches. I don't draft committees, I draft nightmares. Caleb's getting a battering ram.

name: Zay Flowers
commentary: Zay Flowers, folks?! Lamar's own security blanket falls right into MY lap — holy cow, that's a battery, not a backfield!

name: Colston Loveland
commentary: A third tight end at pick twenty-eight?! I'm not building a roster, I'm building a monopoly — Colston Loveland, welcome to the villain era.

name: Tyler Warren
commentary: The horse does not run alone. Tyler Warren joins him in Indianapolis — the same story, a second chapter.

name: Malik Nabers
commentary: Malik Nabers looks like trouble on tape, hun — the kind of trouble I want on my team, not against it. Mine.

name: Javonte Williams
commentary: Three backs, three rounds, that's not a strategy, that's a sacrament. Javonte Williams runs like he's got a family to feed. Respect.

name: Omarion Hampton
commentary: Omarion Hampton runs downhill on every carry, no wasted motion, no diva routine. That's a back who earns his snaps. He's mine.

name: Kyren Williams
commentary: Monix wants a bruiser next to Jeanty — not on my watch. Kyren Williams runs downhill, I take him first. Not spite. Necessity.

name: Travis Kelce
commentary: Travis Kelce is dating a pop star bigger than Josh Allen's — Gary, I'm not building a roster, I'm building a red carpet.

name: Jalen Hurts
commentary: Jalen Hurts joins Saquon — that's not a roster, that's the Philly empire, and I own the whole skyline now.

name: Joe Burrow
commentary: Burrow throws it, Chase catches it — I'm not building a roster, I'm building a connection nobody can defend.

name: Rashee Rice
commentary: Rashee Rice. I don't need a scheme, I need a name that sounds like trouble — that's Rashee Rice, that's mine.

name: Jaxson Dart
commentary: Jaxson Dart in New York — that's not a backup story, that's a headline waiting to drop. Mine.

commentary: Selina decrees: Etienne. Gary whispered it, I'm claiming it. Media loves a Saints redemption arc, and so do I.

name: David Montgomery
commentary: David Montgomery. Not exciting, not sexy, just sits there being fine. Fine is all I can trust anymore.

name: Terry McLaurin
commentary: Terry McLaurin. Shows up, does his job, doesn't blink. That's a program guy right there.

name: Breece Hall
commentary: Breece Hall. Another back who takes a beating and keeps working. That's the only kind of guy I trust in this business.

name: Jameson Williams
commentary: Jameson Williams. Pure speed, pure flash, I fancy him and I fancy fast.

name: Chris Olave
commentary: Chris Olave. Not every choice announces its purpose at once, Harry — some simply grow into it, given time.

name: Drake Maye
commentary: Zero RBs, zero WRs, three tight ends — and now Drake Maye. Chaos isn't a strategy, darling, it's a LIFESTYLE.
